subject: Re: Brightwave MSA – term, auto-renew, and termination-for-convenience tradeoffs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightwave.com>; Brightwave Legal <legal@brightwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Brightwave MSA redline (term + auto-renew + TFC) — initial options

Hi Marta / Brightwave legal team —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. As promised, attached is our suggested redline for the MSA focused on three items we discussed: term length / auto-renew cadence, notice window for non-renewal, and the termination-for-convenience (TFC) carveouts.

Short summary of the commercial asks we tried to capture:
- Term: 12 months initial term (aligned to the Order Form) with annual auto-renew unless either party gives timely notice.
- Auto-renew: standard 12-month renewals; proposal includes a mutual right to opt-out with notice.
- Notice window: proposing 60 days prior to term end for either party to decline renewal.
- TFC: mutual TFC permitted with 60 days' notice; Redwood requests a cap on ramp/down support obligations (see redline).

Why we picked 60 days: it balances Brightwave procurement timelines and Redwood resource planning. If Brightwave prefers 90 days, we need to align on a commercial offset (shorter notice + onboarding credit / pro-rated invoice hold).

Action items from our side: please review the attached Brightwave_MSA_redline_v3.docx and let us know which of the following you prefer by next Tuesday (11/02):
1) Accept mutual 60‑day notice + mutual TFC (Redwood preferred)
2) Move to 90‑day notice (Brightwave asks) with a commercial concession (e.g., 1 month credit on first renewal or extended onboarding support)
3) Keep 60 day notice but remove mutual TFC — in that case Redwood will seek a 6‑month minimum commitment or a termination fee.

I copied Laura and Karthik so we can align legal + commercial quickly. If you prefer a call to walk through, happy to schedule a short 30-minute slot.

Attachments: Brightwave_MSA_redline_v3.docx (docx)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com] | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightwave.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 13:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Brightwave MSA redline (term + auto-renew + TFC) — initial options

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear options. We reviewed with procurement and legal. High level feedback:
- Brightwave prefers a 90-day notice window for non-renewal — procurement cycles here are slower and we need time to budget and elect replacement vendors.
- Regarding TFC: Brightwave would like to remove unilateral TFC rights for both parties (we prefer termination only for material breach or for mutual agreement) unless there is a specified termination fee.

If Redwood needs TFC we would accept it only with a 180‑day minimum commitment or a clearly defined exit fee that covers migration and data transfer assistance.

I've attached our counter redline with comments: Brightwave_MSA_counter_v2.docx. Marta (cc'd) from legal will host any follow-up discussion.

We are open to compromise on the notice window if Redwood can offer a first-year renewal credit or a short onboarding support package.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement | Brightwave
M: +1 917-555-4490
[Attachment: Brightwave_MSA_counter_v2.docx (docx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwave MSA redline (legal take)

Team —

Quick legal perspective after a first pass on Brightwave's counter:
- 90-day notice: acceptable from a legal risk perspective; operationally the longer notice increases our exposure if we cannot reassign capacity quickly. If we accept 90 days, request a two-part mitigation: (a) a non-cancellable minimum on the Order Form for the initial 12 months and (b) a short termination fee formula in Section X to cover committed onboarding and reserved capacity (e.g., pro-rated remainder of the first 3 months' committed fees).
- TFC removal: Brightwave's ask to remove TFC entirely is problematic for our product-led sales where customers need a simple escape path. We should keep mutual TFC but can gate it with a reasonable fee or minimum notice.
- Auto-renew: mutual opt-out language is fine; ensure we include a notice receipt mechanism (email to contract@redwood.com + HubSpot deal flag) to avoid disputes.

Commercial asks for negotiation: if we concede to 90 days, sales will need to offer either a one-time credit or extended onboarding support — Laura / Jasmine, can you advise precise commercial levers (credits or service days)?

I propose we respond with two trade-off packages:
A) 60-day notice + mutual TFC (no fee) — Redwood preferred, minimal commercial concession
B) 90-day notice + mutual TFC + 1 month credit on first renewal (or equivalent onboarding support) — compromise package

If Brightwave insists on removing TFC entirely, legal wants either a termination fee or a minimum 12-month non-cancellable revenue commitment.

Karthik
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 15:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwave MSA redline (commercial framing)

All —

Commercial input from GTM: we can support package B (90-day + 1 month credit) but prefer to price the credit into year-1 TCV rather than discounting indefinitely. Practical proposals:
- Offer either (i) 100% credit of one month's committed fees applied to the first renewal invoice, or (ii) 30 hours of dedicated onboarding services delivered in month 0–2 post-signature.
- If we go with option (ii) onboarding services, Ops (Aditya) will scope whether we can deliver the 30 hours without impacting other pilots.

Please see below a suggested language snippet for the Order Form to capture the credit approach (for Karthik/legal):
"If Customer elects the 90-day notice option, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to the monthly committed fees from the initial Order Form term to the first renewal invoice. Such credit is only available if the initial Order Form is executed and payment obligations are current."

If legal signs off on either the credit or onboarding language, we should surface the two choices back to Brightwave and request their selection in writing. Jasmine — can you push this to Marta and ask for selection by EOD 11/02 so we can lock the Order Form?

Laura Bennett
Strategic Accounts Lead | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-2099

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightwave MSA — next steps and ask for selection

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. To keep momentum and avoid a long redline loop, can you confirm which package Brightwave prefers by EOD Tuesday 11/02 (end of your business day):
- Package A: 60-day notice + mutual TFC (no commercial concession)
- Package B: 90-day notice + mutual TFC + one-time concession (please indicate either: (i) 1 month credit on first renewal OR (ii) 30 hours onboarding support)

If Brightwave still wants removal of TFC entirely, please confirm whether your team would accept a 12‑month non-cancellable revenue commitment or the termination fee language Karthik suggested (we can provide a draft fee table).

Per the attached updated OrderForm_Brightwave_202711.pdf I have reflected the two package choices in the Order Form so legal can pick and we can move to DocuSign once Brightwave confirms.

Attachments: OrderForm_Brightwave_202711.pdf (pdf)

Proposed next steps:
- Brightwave confirms package selection in writing (Marta)
- Redwood legal finalizes clean MSA with selected package and circulates for signature
- Once executed, Laura/Aditya schedule onboarding kickoff if onboarding support selected

Appreciate the collaboration — we want to get this live before end of November.

Thanks,
Jasmine
